beats.desc: the right hand drives a blue-handled screwdriver into the upper mounting screw of the black interior knob and turns it clockwise to fasten the knob to the white door, while the left hand reaches around and steadies the black exterior knob on the other side
the screwdriver moves down to the lower mounting screw of the black interior knob and turns it, seating the round knob base flush against the door
beats.constraint: the screwdriver stays engaged with a knob mounting screw and the left hand stays on the exterior knob.

subject: A man in a plain denim work shirt drives the mounting screws that fasten a black interior door knob to a white door using a blue-handled screwdriver, steadying the exterior knob with his other hand, working with both hands; the man
scene_keep: the white door with a round bored hole showing bare brass and an empty latch cutout above it, the black interior and exterior knobs, and the bright sunny porch with a white railing and green foliage behind
